name: M1-qat
notes: Production model v1 of the autocomplete study (pad/autocomplete, README §2.7): 35.6M parameters, 10 layers x 512, 4-bit weights. Eval v2, 18,060 places in code written in 2026, this package's code: 31.55% exact with the evaluation's prompt, 31.21% with the editor's (prompt.ts Prompter, 192 tokens of headroom). confidence: the cut at which 50/60/70/80% of shown completions are exactly right, measured with the editor's prompt on that set.
